mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booker_profile (order_id, identity_key, guest_name, phone, age, party_type, inferred_region, tags) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{identityKey}, #{guestName}, #{phone}, #{age}, #{partyType}, #{inferredRegion}, CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), order_id = COALESCE(order_id, VALUES(order_id)), guest_name = COALESCE(VALUES(guest_name), guest_name), phone = COALESCE(VALUES(phone), phone)
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, identity_key, guest_name, phone, age, party_type, inferred_region, tags, admin_remark FROM booker_profile WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT profile.id FROM orders AS order_row INNER JOIN booker_profile AS profile ON (profile.phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(order_row.phone) = profile.phone) OR (profile.phone IS NULL AND profile.order_id = order_row.id) WHERE order_row.id = #{orderId} ORDER BY (profile.phone IS NOT NULL) DESC, profile.id LIMIT 1

SELECT order_row.id FROM booker_profile AS profile INNER JOIN orders AS order_row ON (profile.phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(order_row.phone) = profile.phone) OR (profile.phone IS NULL AND profile.order_id = order_row.id) WHERE profile.id = #{profileId} AND order_row.id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
